items.title: Cerebras stock hits post-IPO low, tumbling 20% for the week on Nvidia pressure and lockup expiration
items.description: Cerebras shares hit an all-time low due to pressure from chip giant Nvidia, plus a post-lockup selloff.

items.title: DOJ says it will not reopen criminal probe into former Fed Chair Powell
items.description: The confirmation comes after the Fed's inspector general report that said there were no grounds for a criminal referral over the mismanaged headquarters renovation.

items.title: Anthropic to invest $100 million to train AI engineer talent

items.description: The G7 will deploy 100 million barrels of reserves over the next four months, the group's leaders said in a joint statement.

items.title: 10-year Treasury yield ticks higher despite weaker-than-expected jobs report
items.description: U.S. Treasury yields rose despite a September jobs report came in much weaker than expected.

items.title: G7 nations to release diesel stocks as wars in Europe and Middle East constrain fuel supplies

items.title: FAA says Boeing 737 Max software glitch not a flight-safety issue

items.title: Why Lilly and Novo are betting on amylin to power a new wave of obesity drugs after GLP-1s

items.title: Men are losing ground in the labor market. Here's why

items.title: Ford fends off Hyundai to retain No. 3 U.S. sales position in third quarter

items.title: Labor market faltered in September as jobs increased by just 29,000, unemployment rate rose to 4.2%
items.description: Nonfarm payrolls rose by just 29,000 in September, well below the 84,000 forecast, and the unemployment rate rose to 4.2%, the Bureau of Labor Statistics said.

items.title: Nike shares tumble after weak revenue outlook and layoff plans underway
items.description: Nike's shares dropped for a second straight day of declines after it reported falling revenue and plans to lay off staff.

items.title: Traders now see little chance of a Fed rate hike in October after weak jobs report
